name: @workspec/site
description: The WorkSpec Studio site — free workbench over your WorkSpec artifacts, modules as paths (/decisions, /c4, and /cost, each with its own in-browser demo). Consumes the PUBLISHED @workspec/* packages from npm — if the site builds, those packages work for outside consumers. The @workspec/cost-* packages are a temporary workspace-devDependency exception (not yet published) — see docs/cost/drift-log.md.
_LOUD_NOTICE_devDependencies_cost_packag: The three @workspec/cost-* entries in devDependencies below are workspace:* — NOT registry pins like every other @workspec/* dependency above. The cost packages aren't published to npm yet; this is a deliberate, TEMPORARY exception to this app's registry-pins-only rule, scoped ONLY to cost-schema/cost-engine/cost-ui (the decisions and c4 demos' pins are untouched). See docs/cost/drift-log.md entry 1 and this package's README.md. Flip each to a published semver range and move it up into "dependencies" at first publish — a one-line change per package, mirroring how PR #27 resolved the equivalent c4 exception (docs/c4/drift-log.md entry 17).
